The 4-state unrestricted energy transfer has a nilpotent first-order expansion; its leading trace coefficients give exact ground multiplicities 4 and 2n^2. The 16-state weak-stability transfer is a bijective cyclic encoding, and exact symbolic determinant factorization gives the marked quintic. The active 14-state fifth matrix power is strictly positive, ensuring a unique analytic Perron root and the stated entropy and energy LLN. The attached physical graph checker exhausts all spin configurations through 8 columns and matches the transfer calculations. No dynamical hitting probability or two-dimensional limit is inferred.

value.rationale: This finite-width geometrically frustrated model has a substantive contrast between dynamical absorbing states (zero or four), equilibrium ground states (four or 2n^2), and exponentially numerous metastable configurations that permit neutral flips. The nontrivial explicit quintic growth rate and positive excess-energy law quantify a macroscopic metastable ensemble whose existence is not explained by ground-state entropy. These are physically motivated exact invariants of zero-temperature kinetic trapping and are useful as a benchmark distinguishing state counts from quench outcomes; the central insight is not a simple lattice rescaling or a tiny enumerative improvement.
